_source: capability suites 2026-10-15 (evals/scorecard-20261015.md: Gemma 4 vs Qwen3.6 on the same tooling) and 2026-10-07/08 (evals/scorecard-20261008.md), Godot suite 2026-10-14 (evals/scorecard-godot-20261014.md) on the reference machine: RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB + RTX 2060 6 GB, 64 GB RAM

worker.why: capability suite 2026-10-15, 2 runs per task: 19/20 agent runs passed (mean 0.995; Qwen3.6 on the same tooling 16/20) across coding, UE Python/C++/render, Blender, ffmpeg, audio; 57 min total vs 80, 172 turns vs 401, peak context 45K of 131K; also the Godot worker (8/8), so one model for all agent work and no reloads

retry.why: a different model family from the worker (a retry shouldn't repeat the first attempt's blind spot); 19/20 in the 2026-10-08 suite, 8/8 Godot, best-looking renders by eye; ~3x slower

long_context.why: 3/3 recall at 24K/106K/188K, prefill ~900 tok/s; use for reading huge logs or files beyond ~100K tokens

log_triage_fast.why: 0.75 triage score in ~20 s on the small second GPU; first pass only, Claude confirms

vision_prescreen.why: synthetic frames 2026-10-15: exposure 20/20 twice, defects 8/8 twice (Qwen3.6: 0.93 / 1.00). Pre-screen only: Claude makes the call

harness.why: Claude Code worker: 19/20 per model; OpenCode with the same Bonsai: 7/10, slower, more context

gpu_policy.why: agent context needs 20-112K (too much for the 32K co-resident mode); one worker model for everything avoids reloads; a reload takes ~4-5 s (warm page cache) plus re-reading the worker's context

claude_only: brief, plan, shot design, final creative calls
visual QA verdicts (local vision is pre-screen only)
musical tempo/structure review (graders can't check tempo reliably)

worker.why: Godot suite 2026-10-14/15, 2 runs per task: 8/8 passed, ~31 min per 4 tasks (fastest, fewest turns/context): port 3->4, race logic 21/21, platformer + exports, Movie Maker clip

retry.why: also 8/8 (~91 min per 4 tasks, ~3x slower) and the best-looking clips by eye: retries and look-critical steps

not_recommended.qwen3.6-35b-a3b: 4/8 over 2 runs (rep 2: 3/4 after the tooling fixes): fails the platformer (autopilot timing + time limit)
not_recommended.mellum2.1-12b: 0/4: loses the task inside Claude Code's long system prompt (12B too small for this harness)
not_recommended.qwen3.8-27b-q3: 1/4: limited by the 49K context that fits in 16 GB (template fixed)

log_triage.why: UE log triage 0.88 (2026-10-08); Qwen3.6 0.75, Gemma 4 0.50 (2026-10-15). Claude confirms

fallback_worker.why: 16/20 on the 2026-10-15 suite (missed a key signature, a light, wrote a C++ test with 0 asserts); fastest tokens (77 tok/s) but 2.3x the turns
